profile.headline: GTM Engineer | Think like an AE, ship like an engineer | AI outbound, lead enrichment & voice agents for B2B — systems your team owns | SWE @ ServiceNow
profile.summary:
Most B2B outbound isn't a people problem. It's a systems problem.




I fix that, with production engineering, not Clay tables.




By day I build AI systems at ServiceNow (RAG pipelines, multi-agent orchestration, document intelligence). The rest of the time I run my own GTM engineering practice, where I've shipped the entire revenue machine solo:




- A 12,000-prospect CRM enriched to 71% owner-name coverage at near-zero cost - by reverse-engineering state license-board and business-registry systems (11 resumable scraping streams)

- A CAN-SPAM-compliant outbound engine: segmented cadences, per-prospect click tracking, automated reply detection and cadence cancellation

- Production AI voice agents (Retell + Telnyx) that qualify inbound calls and book meetings straight onto the calendar - including surviving a real robocall attack

- A real-time AI sales-coaching app cut from 15-20s timeouts to 4.8s median responses (Claude Agent SDK)

- A 5-agent autonomous pipeline running daily research, SEO, and content for client businesses




Not theory. Not decks. Systems that ship - and that your team owns when I'm done.




This is the work AI-native companies now hire as GTM Engineers and Forward Deployed Engineers. I do it with a real engineering foundation: before ServiceNow - Sandia National Labs, Deloitte, Sonoco. M.S. Robotics, Northwestern. Security clearances: Secret (DOD) | Q (DOE).




Stack: Python, TypeScript, Claude Agent SDK, RAG, multi-agent orchestration, PostgreSQL, Cloudflare Workers, Playwright, Clay-class enrichment, AI voice, GA4 + first-party telemetry.




Want a revenue system instead of another tool subscription? Book time with me: cal.com/liveanswerservice/personal-meeting-with-asa — or DM me "BUILD".

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built a RAG pipeline that ingested business rules from an affiliate company’s web presence and automatically converted them into ServiceNow-native configurations via agent scripting, reducing manual policy migration effort by an estimated 60–80%

Designed a document intelligence system that extracted text from PDFs and ran automated evaluation against internal quality benchmarks

Designed and implemented RESTful APIs to support full CRUD operations across internal platform tooling for management teams averaging 10,000+ employees
Identified gaps in documentation, configuration, and system behavior through systematic validation and testing

Attended and completed ServiceNow’s Generative AI Bootcamp during onboarding ramp-up
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) · Python (Programming Language) · MySQL · REST APIs · Local LLMs · Angular

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Delivered a 120-story-point feature set for the LeaderHub project, including a delegation system enabling C-suite executives to assign and revoke proxy access with matching permissions and responsibilities
Designed and implemented the RESTful API powering the delegation feature, supporting management teams of 10,000+ employees across the platform

Built the full UI layer using JavaScript, HTML, and ServiceNow’s CSS-adjacent framework with CRUD operations

Developed a UI Modal projected to save system administrators approximately 150 hours of annual manual work

Ramped up through bug fixes and defect resolution before being assigned the largest individual feature on the team

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developed and designed enterprise-level mobile applications to capture dose images and associated data for two military defense contractors using Java, Android Studio, and SQLite

Refactored a predictive application used to estimate timing for combustible devices, primarily built in C#, ASP.NET, and MVC architecture

Designed supplementary tools in React to support internal workflows and data visualization
Coordinated weekly agile ceremonies to maintain code quality and delivery cadence across the team
positions.insights: Skills: Java · C# · ASP.NET · React.js · Android · SQLite · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Led a team of 5 to develop a web application in React that streamlined the remediation process for cloud administrators, built with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS

Configured cloud services across AWS, Azure, and GCP to ensure compliance with Deloitte’s internal cyber policies

Participated in an Innovation Challenge where the team developed a Knowledge Exchange Repository using Angular 2 and RESTful APIs for business continuity
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · JavaScript · Angular · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Microsoft Azure · Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Developed an Android and IOS app to track employee attendance using FLUTTER
• Linked a script, using MS Access and VBA, that populates a SQL database to track scrappage rates
• Created an ASP.NET full stack website that queries live data from a MySQL database to show the current performance of every manufacturing machine using AJAX and JQUERY.
• Developed a tool that uses C# to calculate the speed, items in an order, total items completed, and downtime before displaying that data for each line. Data was presented using HTML and CSS.
• Built a full stack web application using Mongo, Express, React and Node.js (MERN). Application resulted in a 96% reduction in time between orders
• Created a program for plant manager to track scrap percentage during flange manufacturing
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Microsoft Access · Microsoft Excel · Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) · C# · VBA Excel · MongoDB · Express.js · Python (Programming Language) · Node.js · C (Programming Language) · Vba · SQL · ASP.NET · Windows Batch

projects.title: HomeHunt — Property Intelligence Platform
projects.description: Distressed-property sourcing pipeline over ~2.9M parcels across 12 California counties: vendor-adapter scrapers for heterogeneous county tax portals, 504K-parcel GIS ingestion at ~1,300 records/sec, owner/absentee detection, and drive-time ranking — feeding a shipped SwiftUI + Supabase iOS app with 74,000+ imported homes (19 versioned migrations, RLS, PostGIS viewport queries). Designed and built solo — proof of what one GTM engineer ships when data, infra, and product live in the same head.

projects.title: Live Call Coach — Real-Time AI Sales Coaching
projects.description: Streams live phone-call transcripts into a Claude agent loop that renders per-turn sales coaching against a SPIN playbook. Cut response latency from 15–20s timeouts to p50 4.8s via reasoning-effort tuning, session pre-warming, and eager pre-generation off interim transcripts. Two-stream Deepgram STT; runs alongside production Retell + Telnyx voice agents.
